name: jedi-tools
author: lumine-code
description: Navigate and refactor Python with Jedi.

pythonCommand.title: Python Command
pythonCommand.description: Python interpreter command. Supports whitespace-separated arguments, e.g. `python3`, `py -3` or `C:/venv/Scripts/python.exe`. Use `$PROJECT` or `$PROJECT_NAME` for project-specific paths, e.g. `$PROJECT/.venv/Scripts/python.exe`. The daemon restarts automatically when this setting changes.

extraPaths.title: Extra Paths
extraPaths.description: Semicolon-separated list of additional directories added to `sys.path` for symbol navigation and refactoring. Use `$PROJECT` or `$PROJECT_NAME` substitutions. Add the parent of any package not installed in your Python environment.

showErrors.title: Show Errors
showErrors.description: Show Jedi error notifications. Critical errors are always shown regardless of this setting.

debugLogs.title: Debug Logs
debugLogs.description: Log debug output to the developer console. May slow down the editor.

editorScrollZone.title: Editor scroll zone
editorScrollZone.description: Where the cursor lands after jumping to a definition or usage, as a % of viewport height. One value e.g. `25` always scrolls it there. Two are a band it may sit in untouched: `0, 50` moves it to the edge it crossed, `50, 0` throws it to the opposite edge for maximum room ahead. 0 = top margin, 100 = bottom margin.
